activity.role: Reich Minister of Public Enlightenment and Propaganda
activity.notes: Hitler appointed Joseph Goebbels Reich Minister of Public Enlightenment and Propaganda on 13 March 1933; the USHMM records that he held the position until 1945. The end boundary is therefore intentionally kept at year granularity rather than inferring a day from his death.

sources.title: Joseph Goebbels
sources.citation_text: The United States Holocaust Memorial Museum states that Hitler appointed Goebbels Reich Minister for Propaganda and Public Enlightenment on 13 March 1933 and that he held the position until 1945.
